[{"insert":"Suitcase Walking Lunge Progression

The final suitcase walking lunge of the cycle. Reps are at their lowest this week, so this should be the heaviest single leg work of the six weeks. Grip a heavy dumbbell in each hand, use straps as needed, and keep each step controlled and tall. Aim to beat Week 4 across all working sets.
"}]
